options.name: Modern Web Development with React

options.upside: Provides in-depth understanding of container orchestration.

shared_context: A developer conference track needs to select four workshop sessions for six participants. Each session varies in duration, topic focus, and required skill level, and all sessions must accommodate the full group size.

personas.private_goal: To deepen my Kubernetes knowledge and apply it to real projects.

A.reason_for: Covers popular frontend framework with practical exercises, good for broadening skills.

D.reason_for: Focuses on security, an important aspect of DevOps.
D.reason_against: Less hands-on coding, which I prefer.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a frontend developer eager to enhance his React skills and stay current with web technologies.
personas.private_goal: To master React and build more interactive web applications.
